title: Per-table ALTER from the field repository
summary: Makes one Firebird table match the field repository: exact DDL, refused or lossy changes blocked before anything runs, dry run by default
intro: Read this when a column changed in the field repository and the Firebird table must follow. drag-lint repo alter-table prints the exact DDL for ONE table, blocks what Firebird would refuse or would accept and lose data on, and writes only with --apply, after its own pre-checks on the same connection and a verified backup of the database. An opt-in safe path (add, copy, compare, swap) does the changes Firebird refuses.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint repo alter-table --table <T> --direction repo-to-db --connection "<Firebird connection string>" (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--safe-path] [--rename <OLD=NEW[,...]>] [--order <A,B,...>] [--hook <name>] [--select <id file>] [--apply] [--dry-run] [--backup-dir <folder>] [--backup-name <name>] [--verify <full|quick>] [--json]
help: drag-lint repo alter-table    --table <T> --direction repo-to-db --connection "<Firebird connection string>" (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--safe-path] [--rename <OLD=NEW[,...]>] [--order <A,B,...>] [--hook <name>] [--select <id file>] [--apply] [--dry-run] [--backup-dir <folder>] [--backup-name <name>] [--verify <full|quick>] [--json]   (make ONE Firebird table match the repository; prints the change set with the exact DDL and writes NOTHING without --apply; a change Firebird refuses, or accepts and loses data on, is BLOCKED; drops, DROP NOT NULL, safe-path changes and the widening of a column other objects use are unchecked: name their ids, after the plan line of the dry run, in --select; all in that file never takes a drop; --apply first makes a backup, restored and compared unless --verify quick, see repo backup --connection; --safe-path offers add-copy-compare-swap for refused type changes; --hook micronite = the Micronite rules; exit 0 ok, 1 bad arguments or a refused or failed apply)
